notes.title: Achievement bug fix!
notes.notes:
There was a bug where the achievements for completing all levels of a particular difficulty did not trigger. This has now been fixed in the latest update. 
To trigger the fix, you will just need to complete a stage (any stage will do and any star rating).
Thanks for waiting!
